Coach Westhoff is unable to attend tonight and would like the following read for her student athletes.  

“This year was a very great year for the middle school cross country program. The past two years we have had 7 and 8 runners, this year, we ended the season with 17 runners! Both as a team and individually, we saw a lot of success. We brought home medals from every meet, and many times our boys team ended up in the top 3 for team scores. The runners being recognized tonight are Top 10 Conference finishers. Every runner on our team grew so much throughout the year and proved to themselves just how much their body is capable of.  I am very proud of all of them and excited to see what they can accomplish in the future.”

Title: E. Hive Society Monthly Award Winner

fields.Content:
Congratulations to Hive Society's CSD Employee of the Month!  
 
This person exemplifies our core value of "Highly Qualified and Diverse Staff." This person is an absolute rock star in their job. This person inspires learning and personal/professional growth and is a colleague that others look up to as a mentor who makes a quiet difference. 
 
 
CONGRATULATIONS, MR. JOHN DUNN, CENTER ELEMENTARY!   We caught Mr. Dunn on "80's Day" at CE 😉.  (Check out this video for a feel-good moment of CE students cheering for Mr. Dunn.)
 
 
What Mr. Dunn’s colleagues had to say about him:
 
John is our day custodian at Center Elementary. He is very involved with your students and staff. He is always helping even without being asked, especially in the cafeteria when students have needs. He speaks wisdom and affirmation to our students and encourages them to be their best. John serves as a mentor for a few of our students and allows them to contribute to our school community. Center elementary is a better and higher-achieving place because of John Dunn.  
 
December's Hive Society Center School District Employee of the Month exemplifies our core value of "Diversity in Our Schools and Community."  This person continuously finds new ways to celebrate the things that make us all unique. This person is intentional about including diverse perspectives and ideas in decision-making.  This person makes all of us (students and colleagues alike) feel included, respected, and like we belong.  
 Congratulations to Hive Society's CSD Employee of the Month!
